name: Tycho Brahe
biography: Discussed as an important observer rather than theorist, who proposed an intermediate geo-heliocentric system but whose real importance was his patient, decades-long accumulation of precise planetary and stellar observations (including evidence against Aristotle's doctrine of an unchanging heavens, from a new star in 1572 and from comets), later used by his assistant Kepler.
